_comment: The restriction was a RESTRICT_DEFENSE_TO_HEAD_EQUIPMENT inside an APPLY_CONTINUOUS inside a plain STATIC -- dead three ways over, and naming the wrong restriction besides: the card says 'can't be defended by CARDS FROM HAND', which is close to the opposite of 'head equipment only'. Its power test was ATTACK_PITCH_POWER_LTE, which reads the attack's PITCH value, not its {p}. A restriction is created when a qualifying attack is declared, so it is an ON_ATTACK trigger rather than a continuous effect.
